issues: 纯色平铺暗底，没有光源和层次
占位文案 "Your title" 远窄于括号内腔，括号还没拉开字就全露了，"拉幕"读不出来
括号用 800 字重系统无衬线纯白字形，和正文同色同质，看不出代码语感
括号 24f 内弹开 592px，快速段没有任何运动模糊，像逐帧跳位
clip 两侧是硬边裁切，字被切开时边缘生硬
changes: 背景换成暗场柔光 Backdrop（居中主光 + 淡靛蓝余光 + 暗角）+ soft-light 颗粒
文案换成 "Ship it faster"，粗体 38px 宽度贴满 2·HALF−34 内腔，括号拉到头才露全；标题加亮上暗下竖向渐变
括号改等宽字形 500 字重 + 唯一强调色 #8f97ff 与 10px 微光，读作代码符号
按括号中心差分速度给水平 SpeedBlur（max 6 设计 px），只在弹开快速段生效、落定归零
clip 两侧加 5px 羽化遮罩（随 clip 宽度收窄），仍严格绑括号位置；outBack 过冲、7f 硬切出现、字距松弛节拍全部保留
issuesEn: Flat dark fill with no light or depth
Placeholder "Your title" was much narrower than the brace cavity, so it was fully visible long before the braces opened — the curtain read was lost
Braces were 800-weight system sans in plain white, same as the copy, with no code character
Braces travel 592px in 24f with no motion blur in the fast segment, reading as frame-skipping
Hard-edged clip made the cut glyph edges look crude
changesEn: Dark soft-light Backdrop (centered key, faint indigo spill, vignette) plus soft-light grain
Copy changed to "Ship it faster", whose 38px bold width fills the 2·HALF−34 cavity so it is fully revealed only when the braces finish; top-lit vertical gradient on the title
Braces switched to a 500-weight monospace glyph in the single accent #8f97ff with a 10px glow, reading as code syntax
Horizontal SpeedBlur driven by the braces' central-difference velocity (max 6 design px), active only during the fast expansion and zero once settled
5px feathered mask on both clip edges (shrinks with clip width), still strictly bound to brace positions; outBack overshoot, 7f hard-cut appearance and letter-spacing relax all kept
